documentation.content: The process-local sec_edgar breaker opened or reopened in the backend service or a Cloud Run job. Inspect SEC responses and fallback behavior; compare active revisions and job executions. See the operations alert source map and docs/OPERATIONS.md.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: ((resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="earningsnerd-backend") OR resource.type="cloud_run_job") AND ((jsonPayload.message:"Circuit breaker 'sec_edgar' opened after" OR textPayload:"Circuit breaker 'sec_edgar' opened after") OR (jsonPayload.message:"Circuit breaker 'sec_edgar' reopened after" OR textPayload:"Circuit breaker 'sec_edgar' reopened after"))
